name: page-reviews
description: Customer review wall for /client-reviews/: industry chips (with counts) over one industry at a time — a featured story card (client logo, large quote, name and role beside a photo) and a grid of review cards (logo, quote, round headshot, name, role, organisation). Every review is in the page; behaviour.js shows the chosen industry (or all of them) without reloading, where live reloads the page per industry. Without JavaScript every industry shows under its own heading.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

filter_label.description: Accessible name of the chip group.

all_label.description: Text of a chip that shows every industry (empty: no such chip).

default_group.description: Index of the industry shown first (0 = the first group); -1 starts on All.

groups.description: Industries, in chip order. Each: label (required; chip text and the group's h2), featured ({quote, name, role, org (the logo alt), logo, logo_w, logo_h, photo, photo_w, photo_h}; optional), items (array of {quote (required), name, role, org, logo, logo_w, logo_h, photo, photo_w, photo_h}).
